_comment: Sitting members that the Open States /people dump is missing, keyed by district. Merged in by scripts/build-state-leg-incumbents.mjs after the dump is grouped by district. `party` uses Open States' own spelling ("Democratic", "Republican", ...) so it runs through the same mapping as fetched members. Use this only for a seat that is genuinely filled and genuinely absent upstream — a real vacancy should stay empty, and a wrong party is a job for state-leg-party-overrides instead.
_source: North Dakota Legislative Branch, District 11 roster (https://ndlegis.gov/districts/2025-2032/district-11), checked 2026-09-11

11.name: Adam Goldwyn
11.note: Active 2026-06-01, filling the seat of Liz Conmy (D), who died 2026-04-25. North Dakota fills legislative vacancies by district committee appointment rather than by special election, so the seat's last REGULAR election remains 2022 (District 11 is odd-numbered, so it is in ND's 2022/2026/2030 class) and its next is 2026 — the district-level rule already covers this and no per-incumbent override is needed. Open States still reported only 93 of North Dakota's 94 representatives when rechecked on 2026-09-11.
